subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which overflow facts may be shown in end-user channel replies, and should the product promise a concise redacted session label plus estimated budget figures or reserve richer diagnostics for operator logs/status tools?
rationale: The runner can compute several useful facts, but choosing the disclosure boundary and promise level determines privacy, cross-channel portability, and whether estimates can be presented as authoritative.

options.title: Redacted portable diagnostics
options.body: Show a channel-safe session display label, selected model, clearly marked estimated budget/overage when available, and reset/model-switch guidance; retain raw identifiers and file paths in logs.

options.title: Operator diagnostics only
options.body: Keep channel replies concise and expose detailed session, token, and recovery facts only through logs or a status/doctor surface.

options.title: Broader per-channel detail
options.body: Design channel-specific detailed notices, including richer session diagnostics, after an explicit privacy and transport review.

recommendation.title: Redacted portable diagnostics
recommendation.body: Show a channel-safe session display label, selected model, clearly marked estimated budget/overage when available, and reset/model-switch guidance; retain raw identifiers and file paths in logs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent compaction and auto-reply work spans the user-visible recovery boundary where this disclosure contract must be owned.
